description.en: When a session invokes the GenOffice task-list skills (GenOffice_XLSX_Tasklist, /GenOfficeXLSXTasklistOrchestration), launches GenOffice for solo work or opens a DESIGNATE THE CAPTAIN pane with a No Orchestration switch and a session dropdown; designating stars that session, tells it it is the Captain and launches GenOffice. Bundles both skills.
description.zh: 当会话调用 GenOffice 任务清单技能（GenOffice_XLSX_Tasklist、/GenOfficeXLSXTasklistOrchestration）时，单会话工作直接启动 GenOffice，否则打开 DESIGNATE THE CAPTAIN 面板，提供“无编排”开关和会话下拉框；指定后为该会话标注星标、告知其为 Captain 并启动 GenOffice。内置两项技能。
